findings.summary: Provenance incident (pre-tombstone-process): this push-triggered one-shot cleaner permanently deleted 21 completed runs' raw logs at 2026-08-24T23:42Z, including TWO claim-bearing SPIDER Graph Lane runs (32776369696 success; 32689296167 failure) and two failed 'Launch First Intel Cycle' dispatchers. Loss assessed via Git: both Graph Lane runs' scientific content is durable (cycle/* team+audit branches survive; director-integrated into lab/graph via f42c14d 'integrate audited Graph run 32776369696 (gate PASS)' and c1dd8e3 'integrate: Graph run 32689296167 repaired snapshot'), so claim-level loss is NONE_MATERIAL; only log-only operational diagnostics (agent transcripts, timing) are irrecoverable. The 14 supervisor/watchdog/dispatcher deletions carry no scientific provenance.

Keep-rule design flaw: 'keep latest completed run per current workflow name' also deletes OLDER completed runs of ACTIVE workflows, not merely runs of retired workflows. That is how two Graph Lane cycle runs were destroyed while their branches survived. A retention rule for autonomous-research repos must protect every run that owns cycle/* branches or an un-distilled record, not just the newest run per workflow name.

The deletion manifest above exists ONLY in this run's raw log (the workflow emitted no receipt). Together with run 32880942022's later 102-run manifest it forms the complete pruning history of the repository; the two events are disjoint by run id. This bundle's log is therefore non-renewable provenance.

Branch inventory snapshot at 2026-08-24T23:42Z (from fetch log): lab/graph, lab/intel, lab/physics, main, infra/parallel-audit-lanes, spider/lab-v2-audited, spider/physics-cycle-32670239235, tmp-orchestration-fix(+ -staged), three opencode/dispatch-* branches, and cycle/* branches for runs 32670239235 (old-style layout audit/director/graph/physics), graph 32676576613/32684818422/32689296167/32776369696/32782331702/32783797303, physics 32676578274/32682634851/32689298051, intel 32781482957/scout. Useful as a historical map of which cycle branches existed before the 2026-08-25 lane-cycle wave.

~20s total runner time (16s prune loop incl. 21 DELETE calls + 2s commit/push of the self-removal). Self-cleaning design (workflow deletes its own file from main) prevented recurrence by construction.

failure_signatures: KEEP_LATEST_ONLY_DELETES_ACTIVE_WORKFLOW_HISTORY: recency-based pruning without cycle-branch/distillation awareness silently destroys provenance of claim-bearing scientific runs.
